policies.title: Arrival and departure
policies.body: Fictional demo policy. All times are in Europe/Kyiv. Check-in starts at 15:00. Checkout is by 11:00. Early check-in and late checkout need staff confirmation and are not guaranteed by an open inventory night. Luggage storage is available from 07:00 to 22:00. Fees for special arrangements are not published.

policies.title: Pets and access
policies.body: Fictional demo policy. Pets are not permitted except assistance animals arranged with staff. Step-free access is not confirmed. Ask staff before relying on accessible accommodation. No live staff contact is configured in this demo.

policies.title: Family and occupancy
policies.body: Fictional demo policy. Adults, children and infants all count towards room capacity. Manor Suite holds two guests; Garden Room holds four guests. No extra beds are available. A cot may be requested for a child under two, subject to staff confirmation; it does not increase capacity.

policies.title: Cancellation terms
policies.body: Fictional demo policy. For a flexible rate, cancellation is free by 23:59 Europe/Kyiv time seven calendar days before check-in. Later cancellation or a no-show has a charge of one accommodation night. A non-refundable rate has a full-stay charge for cancellation or a no-show. Ask which rate applies; do not infer it from the room. This demo has no paid rates or published room prices, so no monetary fee can be calculated. Cancellation, changes and refunds require staff review; this data reader cannot perform them.

policies.title: Room prices and service fees
policies.body: Room prices, currency and service fees have not been set for this fictional demo. Do not quote amounts or assume a free service.

policies.title: Demo reservation limits
policies.body: Royal Crest Manor is fictional. Any later reservation feature must label reservations as demo only and require explicit guest confirmation. Reading hotel information or inventory does not reserve or hold a room. This task provides data only; it does not create reservations.
